Container.Name: unifi-analyzer
Container.Overview:
UniFi Analyzer collects your UniFi network logs (via Graylog or directly from the controller), sends them to any OpenAI-compatible LLM (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, ...) for analysis, and emails you a daily report with a traffic-light status (green/yellow/red).
Optional add-ons: AbuseIPDB reputation lookups for public IPs seen in the logs, automatic blocking of malicious IPs on the UniFi gateway (dry-run by default), and SearXNG-based research on unusual error messages.
Everything is configured through the web UI after first start - no required environment variables. Settings are stored persistently under /data/settings.json.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for the daily schedule and log timestamps

Config.Name: LLM Endpoint
Config.Description: Optional initial value: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. LM Studio/Ollama). Can also be set later in the web UI.

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Optional initial value: model name at the LLM endpoint. Can also be set later in the web UI.

Config.Name: Report recipient
Config.Description: Optional initial value: recipient address for the daily report. Can also be set later in the web UI.
